scenarios.interpretation: Tests on the old candidate are not fresh applicability evidence; Git/hash comparison could also detect the changed original.
Guard provides an explicit binding check; recomputed native patch hashes could provide equivalent detection.
Guard enforces approved scope at verification; ordinary Git plus a scope checker can enforce this too.

limitations: These cases do not establish an agent correctness effect.
Neither Git nor Guard is a malicious-code sandbox.
Native tests and Guard use the same behavioral assertions; their detection power must not be double-counted.
